response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope

assumptions.assumption: The expirespot comparison is done as text, as the request says, using inclusive string bounds. Executions are counted via inner joins to orders and users, so executions without a matching order or user are excluded.
Each row in orderexecutions counts as one execution, and recordvault and userstamp are unique, so the joins do not duplicate rows.
